messages:
maya (partnerships): Heads-up — partners asking for a clearer forward-compat story for SDKs when we introduce breaking model response fields. want to propose a canary + graceful-fallback pattern. thoughts?

owen (eng): +1. short version: try non-breaking extensions first, then canary server-side changes, and SDKs expose a compatibility flag.

lena (partner-ops): partners need a single, simple checklist they can run. also want explicit telemetry events so we can tell who gets the new path.

derek (platform): for canaries i suggest a policy object we can deploy per partner: percent, window, rollback threshold. minimal example:```
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration_hours: 72
  rollback_on_error_rate_pct: 10
```

owen (eng): SDK change strategy: add `X-Client-Min-Version` header support and server responds with `1001` style code for forward-incompatible responses. not an actual HTTP code, just encoded in JSON envelope.

maya (partnerships): can we avoid inventing new envelope codes? partners will hate parsing. maybe `compatibility` object in response meta: `{ "status":"incompatible","required_client":"2.5.0" }`

lena (partner-ops): +1 on response meta. also propose we add a partner-facing opt-in flag `enable_forward_compat_canary=true` in partner portal so marketplace vendors can toggle.

derek (platform): implementation note: routing rules need to honor both partner flag and global canary. priority: partner opt-in > partner-level percent > global percent.

ownen (eng): SDKs: expose `compatibilityHandler` callback so apps can either fallback to older parsing or surface a partner-friendly upgrade modal. example: `client.onCompatibility(({required_client}) => ...)`

maya (partnerships): communications: we should send a short one-pager and a migration checklist with code snippets. target channels: vendor portal email, marketplace release notes, and a joint webinar for big partners.

lena (partner-ops): timeline proposal: announce 2-week notice, start partner canaries week 3, open marketplace-wide switch week 6. emergency rollback plan documented.

derek (platform): telemetry: emit `partner_canary_assignment` and `compatibility_failure` events. namespacing: `partner.<partner-id>.compat_failure`. partner-bot will log to partner channels.

partner-bot: [automated] Created canary policy template at https://internal.redwood/partner-canaries/templates/forward-compat-v1.md :thumbsup:

owen (eng): small snippet we should include in checklist for SDKs to do graceful fallback:```js
if (resp.meta && resp.meta.compatibility === 'incompatible') {
  // try legacy parse path
  return legacyParse(resp);
}
```

maya (partnerships): who owns the partner-facing docs? i can draft the one-pager and webinar slides if eng provides the checklist and code snippets.

lena (partner-ops): i'll schedule the webinar and assemble partner contact list for staggered invites.

derek (platform): i'll send a PR with routing and telemetry hooks by EOD Thu. owens, can you add SDK API for `compatibilityHandler`?

ownen (eng): yep — will prototype tomorrow.

maya (partnerships): ok, next sync: Mon 10am PT. agenda: share PR links, review checklist draft, finalize partner canary percent buckets.

lena (partner-ops): noted. thanks all :raised_hands:
